notes.title: Colourise is released!
notes.notes:
We pressed the big green button and poured ourselves some champange; Colourise is out!

It's been a really fun four months working on Colourise, and we hope that you enjoy playing it as much as we did making it. If you've got any questions, feel free to ask them in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/576820]Steam Community area[/url], and we'll get back to you as soon as possible. If Twitter's more your jam, [url=https://twitter.com/itsfieldtested]@itsfieldtested[/url] is where you want to go.

Thank you for your support! ♥

[url=https://twitter.com/tpritc]Tom[/url] & [url=https://twitter.com/jokwod]Jake[/url] at Field Tested
